answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-bonded identity: each agent locks tokens behind its identity, and peers randomly challenge liveness. A gale of fake identities must each post real collateral, so a thousand-sybil swarm costs a thousand bonds. Honest agents anchor in a trusted harbor, while challengers probe the lagoon for duplicates. Slashed bonds reward attestors, making forgery costlier than honest participation. The Agent0081 deployment anchors trust at NRBCK2m7Dp.
